analysis.title: Global Equity Strategy: 2027 Outlook: Finding Value in Growth
key_insights: GS sees upside for global equities over the next 12 months: S&P 500 target 8,700 from 7,619 (+14% price, +16% total return), STOXX 600 700 from 663 (+6% price, +9% total), TOPIX 4,500 from 3,929 (+15%), MSCI AP ex Japan 960 from 819 (+17%), MSCI EM 1,850 from 1,576 (+17%). Data as of Nov 12, 2026.
Most equity markets generated similar returns over the past 12 months in local currency, and earnings revisions have been unusually positive.
MSCI AC World 12m forward P/E is 15.6x and the PEG ratio is 1.1, both around their 35-year historical averages.

Earnings growth is poised to more than halve across major markets in 2027. GS top-down S&P 500 EPS growth goes from 36% in 2026 to 18% in 2027 in the top-down chart, versus consensus of 32.4% to 16.5%.

The earnings boost from hyperscaler AI capex should fade. Estimated contribution to S&P 500 EPS growth by capex and depreciation runs 2 pp, 5 pp, 12 pp, 9 pp and -5 pp across 2024-2028 on the chart's labels.
Value has sharply outperformed Growth across all regions, and the valuation gap has closed: Value is no longer as cheap and Growth is no longer as expensive on 12m forward P/E premium.

Global technology valuations have de-rated sharply versus their own history and versus other sectors. IT is at 14.1x forward P/E, Hardware at 14.2x, Hyperscalers at 19.7x and EM IT at 6.4x on the chart labels.
The valuation premium of the largest US companies has narrowed: the top 5 stocks' forward P/E premium over the other 495 has shrunk. Technology net debt/equity remains well below market levels.
Long-term yields remain elevated, but GS expects some relief in 10-year yields (US, Germany, UK), which should support equities.
Cyclicals have de-rated sharply relative to Defensives across US, Europe, Japan, EM and AC World.
GS focuses on three themes: Growth scarcity, selective Defensives, and beneficiaries of lower oil prices and bond yields.

US themes: Hyperscalers, AI-enabled revenues, Energy Equipment & Services and the Growth factor; Healthcare and Buyback Aristocrats as defensives; Transportation and long-duration growth with an underweight in Energy for lower yields/oil.
Japan themes: AI semiconductors, AI data center hardware, critical tech, physical AI, cybersecurity; low AGM rating, governance winners, unrealized real estate gains; long-duration SMID growth.

Asia and EM themes: Asia favors positive EPS revisions, selective AI and Korean memory, optical networking, power, and healthcare. EM favors selective tech/AI, energy security, India domestic demand, CEEMEA banks, ZA gold miners, and underweights Energy.
Europe themes: Technology, Defense, Renewables for growth; Telecoms and Utilities as defensives; Telecoms, Utilities, Retailers, UK Real Estate and DAX for lower yields, with Energy underweight.
The US has stronger fundamentals (ROE difference vs MSCI World ex USA) but its P/B premium does not look excessive. EM devalued sharply through 2026 versus DM on forward P/E.
Sector 2027 consensus EPS growth: IT 45.3%, Health Care 17.7%, Industrials 13.7%, Energy -11.3%, Communication Services -5.2%. Energy sales growth goes from 27.4% in 2026 to -7.0% in 2027.

sector_views.rationale: Tech valuations have de-rated sharply, and GS favors Hyperscalers, AI-enabled revenues and AI semiconductors as a growth scarcity theme.
Listed as a selective defensive in the US, Asia and EM.
GS is underweight Energy in the US, EM, Europe and Asia-related themes as a lower-oil-price beneficiary view. Consensus has 2027 Energy EPS at -11.3%.
Selective defensives and lower-yield beneficiaries in Europe.
Beneficiary of lower inflation, oil prices and bond yields.

earnings_insights: GS top-down EPS growth estimates, 2026 then 2027: S&P 500 36% then 18%, STOXX 600 24% then 11%, TOPIX (FY basis) 7% then 9%, MXAPJ 26% then 26%, MSCI EM 74% then 66%, as read from the chart labels. The chart label ordering is ambiguous in the extracted text.

Consensus (FactSet/STOXX) EPS growth 2026E then 2027E: S&P 500 32.4% then 16.5%, STOXX 600 23.6% then 8.4%, TOPIX 21.7% then 13.2%, MSCI AP ex Japan 76.6% then 30.0%, MSCI EM 77.3% then 28.5%, MSCI AC World 35.6% then 17.0%.

Consensus sales growth 2026E then 2027E: S&P 500 12.8% then 9.0%, STOXX 600 8.9% then 2.8%, TOPIX 6.5% then 4.6%, MSCI AP ex Japan 22.4% then 16.6%, MSCI EM 23.0% then 15.8%, AC World 12.8% then 8.5%.
Consensus net margins 2026E then 2027E: S&P 500 16.2% then 17.1%, STOXX 600 11.2% then 11.8%, AC World 14.9% then 15.9%.
The 2027 EPS growth column in the forecast table is 11% S&P 500, 7% STOXX 600, 9% TOPIX, 26% MSCI AP ex Japan and 26% MSCI EM.
